title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Number C40: Gimmick Puppet of Dark Strings LDS3-EN065 Ultra 1st Ed NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! card is an ultra-rare Number C40: Gimmick Puppet of Dark Strings from the LDS3-EN065 set. It features a holographic finish and is a 1st edition card. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and is in excellent shape. 

The card belongs to the Xyz card type and is an English language card manufactured by Konami in the United States. It is not autographed and is not a vintage card. The card size is Japanese and it is perfect for collectors and players of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game.
